title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: When the team keeps losing
hook: Your team has not won yet. How do you keep them going?
intro: Kids are starting to expect it.
statement: A team needs wins it can see, even small ones.
q1: Do you set small goals that are not about the score —
q2: or keep chasing a first win together?
q3: What did the team do better than last week?
t1: Every team is different. But kids keep showing up
t2: when they can see themselves getting better.
cta: Coaches — how do you keep a team going?
ctaLines: Small goals. Celebrate progress. Keep it fun.
Small wins or the big one?
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Your team has not won yet. How do you keep them going?
Five games, five losses. Kids are starting to expect it.
A team needs wins it can see, even small ones.
Small goals or chasing the first win. Both can work.
How do you keep a team going? Share your habit in the comments.
